media:group.media:title: [Day 2] - 2026 BOK-CEPR-OECD Conference
media:group.media:description:

Session 3 – Population Ageing and Technological Progress Keynote - Kwanho Shin, Professor of Economics, Korea University "Demographic Change, Economic Growth, and Technological Adaptation"
Paper Presentation - Matthias Schief, Economist, OECD "A Boost from AI in Ageing Societies? Early Insights"
Paper Presentation - Chulhee Lee, Professor of Economics, Seoul National University "The Rise of Artificial Intelligence and Labor-Market Imbalances Resulting from Population Change in Korea."
Panel Discussion Panelists - Kwanho Shin, Professor of Economics, Korea University - Matthias Schief, Economist, OECD - Chulhee Lee, Professor of Economics, Seoul National University
Moderator - TaeKyung Kim, Head of Demographic & Labor Economic Studies Team, Economic Research Institute, Bank of Korea
Q&A Session

Paper Presentation - Eseul Choi, Economist, Micro and Institutional Economic Studies Team, Economic Research Institute, Bank of Korea “A Development Strategy for the Advanced Biohealth Industry”
Policy Panel: Bold Policy Innovation for Prosperity in an Ageing and Shrinking Korea Panelists - Andrew Scott, Professor of Economics, London Business School; Director of Economics, Ellison Institute of Technology - Åsa Johansson, Director of the Policy Studies Research Branch, Economics Department, OECD - David Canning, Professor of Population Sciences and Economics, T.H. Chan School of Public Health, Harvard University - Youngseok Shin, President, Korea Institute for Health and Social Affairs
Moderator - Seungho Nah, Director General of Economic Research Institute, Bank of Korea
Q&A Session
Closing of the Conference - Seungho Nah, Director General of Economic Research Institute, Bank of Korea
